findings.title: cladding_trim_fit band-lap threshold is the model's own leg-minus-slot, with no cited minimum lap, so it cannot fail

evidence.measured: required = hypot(leg) - BAND_PANEL_GAP_IN = 2.5 - 1.0 = 1.50 in; measured lap = band_panel_top(joint) - min(trim body z) = 1.59 in (7 joints, PASS). Both sides move one-for-one with BAND_PANEL_GAP_IN, so lap - required stays 0.09 in whatever the slot is. BBD75 p.40 publishes the 2-1/2 in leg and no minimum lap on the panel.
evidence.expected: A cited minimum lap (or a stated 'none published') against which the slot, 1.0 in, is graded.
evidence.method: Read cladding_trim_fit.py:244-271; checks.json 'band joints lap the lower panel 1.59 in, 1.50 in needed'; vary BAND_PANEL_GAP_IN mentally. Round-1 adjudication C4 E2-001 said the threshold needs a cited value first.
